acceptanceCriteria: A spec amendment defines how a caller supplies bounded commit facts and how rows for a named commit are pinned.
Frozen cases cover a reachable commit, an unknown commit and an ambiguous prefix, and the compiler itself still reads no history.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from V1-0192. LCP-V0-013 resolves a commit mention only as a prefix of the bound commit; any other commit reports anchor-evidence-unavailable because the prompt compiler reads no history (LCP-V0-011). A prompt such as `revert 1a2b3c4` therefore gets no evidence. Resolving it needs Git facts acquired by the caller under a bound, pinned to immutable objects, without making the compiler read history.
title: Resolve task mentions of commits other than the bound commit from caller-acquired Git facts
